description: This is a Java Spring Boot REST controller class for managing shopping cart operations in an e-commerce application, including retrieving, adding, updating, and removing items from the cart.

classes.name: CartController
classes.description: REST controller class providing endpoints to manage the shopping cart, including CRUD operations on cart items.

methods.name: toCartItemResponse
methods.description: Converts a CartItem object into a CartItemResponse DTO for API responses.

methods.name: toCartResponse
methods.description: Converts a Cart object into a CartResponse DTO including its items and last updated timestamp.

methods.name: getOrCreateCart
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's cart or creates a new one if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: getCart
methods.description: Endpoint to retrieve the user's current shopping cart.

methods.name: addToCart
methods.description: Endpoint to add a product to the user's shopping cart.

methods.name: updateCartItem
methods.description: Endpoint to update the quantity of a specific cart item.

methods.name: removeFromCart
methods.description: Endpoint to remove an item from the cart.

methods.name: clearCart
methods.description: Endpoint to remove all items from the cart.
